'''Asparagus''' is an [[aboveground]] [[crop|garden vegetable]]. It can be planted in all seasons, and is edible raw or [[cooking|cooked]].

Some [[Dwarf|dwarves]] [[preferences|like]] asparagus for their ''delicious shoots''.
